# Google / Gemini CLI policy reference

Checked 2026-10-11. Read the repository README's **Data policy** section before uploading confidential documents. Follow [chat response rules](chat-start.md); any actual reply permits the task to continue without proof of reading.

[Gemini CLI terms and privacy](https://geminicli.com/docs/resources/tos-privacy/) maps the applicable notices to authentication: Google-account Code Assist access, Gemini Developer API paid/unpaid services, or Vertex AI. Subscription and organization arrangements can change the applicable scope. Consult the route you actually use; a Gemini model name does not identify it. Do not promise a training setting, retention period or offline processing, or change account settings for the user. If the model/provider differs, the user should consult its applicable policy. Recommendations remain pending evaluation.
